_readme: A transit day belongs to TWO cities: you wake, check out and travel in the origin city, and you
arrive, check in and sleep in the destination. Notion stores one day record per date and files it
under the destination, so the origin-city morning vanished from the canvas — Guilin showed a single
day even though you sleep there and leave from a Guilin wharf at 07:00.
Each entry splits one source date into two rendered days. The departure hub and everything before
it go to the origin city; the arrival hub and everything after stay with the destination. The
journey between them is still absorbed, so nothing is counted twice.
`meals` lists meals to place on the origin half. Notion carries no Breakfast for these dates because
the whole date was filed under the destination, but you are in a hotel you slept in — so breakfast
is real and has to be shown, even if it ends up being a packed one.

splits.originTheme: Check out and board — the Li River ferry leaves from the Guilin side
splits.why: You sleep in Guilin on the night of 29-30 Aug and the Zhujiang Wharf call is 07:00, so this morning is Guilin's, not Yangshuo's. Notion dates 30 August to Yangshuo, which hid it.
